result.summary: Found 2 visible issues: the promotional banner is difficult to read, and horizontally scrolling content is awkwardly clipped at the right edge.

issues.description: The white headline and subtext in the pale mint promotional banner have extremely low contrast and are nearly invisible.
issues.suggestion: Use substantially darker text or darken the banner background to meet WCAG contrast requirements.

issues.description: The category row and “Fastest near you” carousel cut off items at the right viewport edge; the partially visible category pill has no readable label, and the third restaurant’s name and delivery details are truncated.
issues.suggestion: Adjust card widths and trailing padding so partial items look like an intentional scroll cue, while keeping labels from being clipped.
